mapper.insert: insert into builder.adk_builder_frd_interview_message (id, frd_id, seq, role, kind, content, question_topic, question_reason, options_json) values (#{id}, #{frdId}, #{seq}, #{role}, #{kind}, #{content}, #{questionTopic,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{questionReason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{optionsJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select: select id, frd_id, seq, role, kind, content, question_topic, question_reason, options_json, created_at from builder.adk_builder_frd_interview_message where frd_id = #{frdId} order by seq

select id, frd_id, seq, role, kind, content, question_topic, question_reason, options_json, created_at from builder.adk_builder_frd_interview_message where frd_id = #{frdId} and kind = 'QUESTION' order by seq desc limit 1
